🏙 Could you imagine paying hundreds of dollars a month to live in a room barely bigger than a parking space?
Behind Hong Kong’s glittering skyscrapers lies a shocking reality: coffin homes, soaring housing costs, and millions of people struggling to find an affordable place to call home.
But there’s more to Hong Kong than its housing crisis. It’s also a city of incredible resilience, vibrant street life, and people who refuse to give up despite the challenges they face.
🎥 Watch until the end to discover the hidden side of one of the world’s richest cities.
👇 Now we want to hear from YOU:
Would you rather live in a tiny room in Hong Kong or move somewhere with a lower cost of living? Why?
💬 Share your thoughts in the comments — we’d love to hear your perspective!
